query:
SELECT
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM map_families WHERE id = $1 AND owner_id = $2
                ) as "owner!",
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM user_restrictions
                    WHERE user_id = $2 AND kind = 'map_publishing'::restriction_kind
                        AND start_time <= now() AND end_time > now()
                ) as "restricted!"
